task: Fit known TRAIN trajectory using original fixed prefix2,3 and absolute relative time. Diagnostic of representability/optimization, NOT a causal stepper or heldout prediction.
precedent: Earlier single-case coordinate PINN already achieved about5%U/8%p on temporal heldout slices. This probe specifically tests current prefix-conditioned V4 family on the same known case used for failed steppers, at96/192width.
model: Existing StatePINNv4 with hardIC atframe3; primitive3outputs,softNS(.01)/obstacleBC(.01). Initial fields always supplied. No later flowfield inputs. Freshseeded training, not loading recurrent checkpoint.
data: Uniform shuffled cycle over238futureTRAINframes;2048fluidpoints/update. Normalize data errors by trainStd (different from stepper .05trainStd). Continuous PDE jittered interior256points/update afterwarmup. No cropwalls.
evaluation: All238directtimequeries atinitial-trainingupdate1/every5000/end; same known TRAIN sequence selects best. Perframe errors/divergence retained. Timing includes context/currentprefix features already GPU; label as direct query, NOT causal step latency.
decision: If direct fit is good while recurrence is poor, recurrence/task formulation merits change. If direct fit poor, inspect capacity/optimization. Neither outcome proves a unique cause because representation/loss/time formulation differ.
preservation: Separate best/last/history/config/fullperframe/timing/scheduler receipts; previous results unchanged; all large arrays/weights on Perun.
smoke: 3updates eachwidth,activePDE; hardIC asserted, full238field scoring and finite gradients required before fullrun.
